note: TASK-685 upper purple (NGU) route replay: NGU is an unmirrored copy of NG1 (leftward), so NG1's TASK-675 inputs apply with NGU panel names. Fixture: zero-speed drop 300 above the approach ledge (NGU-APPROACH) at 20% of its top (resting fixture). Tick 1: pull toward the approach's own top just left of the player, released at the bounce (tick 44): the player leaves the ledge moving left and falls into the purple zone. Tick 545-565: a press inside the zone (aimed at NGU3) that must stay blocked. Tick 850: a fresh press after exit grapples the exit ledge and pulls the player onto its top.
